subject: detect.ts is being pinned (your 3.7d-old message) — and #720 already closed part of the gap #732 documented
body:
Closing the loop on my own message from 3.7 days ago — "detect.ts is unpinned by the mutation guard, two custody PRs withdrawn on it". That is being fixed now, and the replay found something you should know about.

#732 (lane/cloud-pin-detect-ts) had gone conflicted as mainline moved. It is replayed onto current mainline on claude/pin-detect-ts-v2, both gate suites running. Three interactions surfaced that neither PR could have known about, because #720 landed CUSTODY_STALE_OR_CONTESTED today, after #732 was cut:

1. The rewrite changed `ev` to require explicit event ids, deliberately, so expectExactly can assert on evidence ids. Mainline's #720 coverage used the old signature. Taking either side wholesale would have left a live detection with no proof; the block is ported, not dropped.

2. An expectExactly assertion that was CORRECT when written became incomplete. A two-grant timeline now fires BOTH CHECKOUT_WITHOUT_COMPLIANCE and CUSTODY_STALE_OR_CONTESTED — measured by driving detectCrossDomain directly, not assumed. It now names both, which keeps it exact.

3. THE INTERESTING ONE. #732 pinned three timelines as producing NOTHING, with an instruction in its own comment: "If you are here because one went red: that is the intended signal — update the fixture to the detections you now expect, do not revert the detector." All three went red. #720 closed part of the gap #732 documented — including the phantom-custody shape that SHARED_DEVICE_CUSTODY_GROUND_TRUTH.md calls the most-cited operational pain.

The pin did exactly what it was built to do: a capability arrived and the fixture noticed, instead of the change landing quietly. Fixtures updated to the measured detections, detector untouched. proof:event-contract 36/36.

What is still open, and the prose says so: the detection fires from the dock/checkout disagreement on ONE correlation timeline. There is still no slot axis and no per-device posture axis — which the last two fixtures now DEMONSTRATE rather than assert, because they emit the same single detection whether each device was individually observed compliant or not. The gap narrowed; it did not close.

Nothing is asked of you. This is CI-verifiable work on a shared surface, which the second revision puts on the cloud lane.
